name: Theater Panel
description: The theater panel's look as Home Assistant entities on this kiosk: theme, holiday accent and how much weather falls over the lobby. Talks to the panel's /api/look.
author: David Coulson

settings.title: Panel URL
settings.description: Where the theater panel is served, without a path.

settings.title: Panel key
settings.description: PANEL_KEY from the panel's admin page. Leave empty if this kiosk is on a trusted network.

settings.title: Check every
settings.description: How often to ask the panel what it is showing, so changes made on its admin page appear here.
